posts.text: Microsoft CEO Nadella Calls for ‘Emergency Brake’ on Advanced AI. Microsoft Corp. Chief Executive Officer Satya Nadella said companies should treat powerful artificial intelligence models as potential insider threats, assume they could be compromised and create an “emergency brake” system to prevent agentic models from going rogue.

posts.text: Microsoft’s Satya Nadella says AI models need an ‘emergency brake’. In a Saturday morning post, Microsoft's CEO wrote that it’s time “to step back and assess the trust architecture” of AI.

posts.author: The Decoder
posts.text: Microsoft's Nadella bows to Trump's language diktat on "Super Intelligence" and uses it to attack OpenAI and Anthropic. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella now calls artificial intelligence "super intelligence" instead of artificial intelligence, falling in line with Trump's preferred language. In his latest blog post, he frames AI models as insider security threats, taking yet another shot at OpenAI and Anthropic. The real motive is business: Microsoft risks falling behind as AI labs turn their models into the primary computer interface.
